rubric_verdicts: RUBRIC legibility: pass - both panels read at a glance. Left: two horizontal bars, 'deciding path' 4 and 'cohort runner' 16-pt category labels, values 4 and 72 labelled directly at the bar ends, x-axis 'undecided documentation items' with ticks 0/20/40/60/80. Right: two point-with-interval marks 14-pt category ticks 'names' and 'documentation', y-axis 'Jev minus incumbent accept rate' with ticks -0.05 to 0.30 in 0.05 steps, values +0.043 and +0.220 labelled directly. Nothing is small or crowded; every number a reader needs is on the figure.

RUBRIC data_ink: pass - the ink is the data. The four counts are flat solid fills (teal #246c78 for the 72-item 'cohort runner' bar, grey #929292 for the 4-item 'deciding path' bar) and the two differences are a flat 2.6 pt marker-plus-interval in the same teal. A colour census of the 1400x720 render counts 64,784 teal and 3,432 grey pixels against 921,428 white: no gradient, no ghosted layer, no duplicated encoding, and the 1.2 pt dotted grey zero rule (line2d_18) is a single reference stroke, not fill.

RUBRIC decoration: pass - no gradient, no background fill and no decorative styling. The axes carry only a left and a bottom spine and no top or right spine: the SVG declares exactly four spine paths (patch_3, patch_4 on the left panel; patch_8, patch_9 on the right) and a scan of rows y=100..102 across x=180..640 finds every pixel pure white where the left panel's top edge would be. There are no gridlines and no shaded bands; the one dotted element is the zero reference on the value axis, which is an axis cue rather than ornament.

RUBRIC contrast: pass - all text clears its background. Tick, category and axis labels are near-black (#52514E, about 7.7:1 on white) with the direct value labels in teal #246c78 (about 6:1). The mid grey #929292 (about 3.1:1) is used only for a filled bar mark and for the dotted zero rule, never for small text, which is the role the style sheet reserves it for.

RUBRIC table_form: pass - neither panel depicts what is naturally a table. The left panel compares two magnitudes (4 and 72 undecided documentation items) as bars, and the right panel shows two paired accept-rate differences with 95% intervals as points with ranges; a table could hold the numbers but would not show the ratio in the left panel or the position relative to zero in the right. The numbers are additionally given as direct labels rather than left to be read off the axes.

RUBRIC label_collision: pass - no label is clipped, overlaps another label, or sits over data. A scan of the outer 3 px of the 1400x720 canvas finds no non-white pixel, so nothing is cut at the edge; a scan of the 40 px band between the panels (x=655..695) finds about 55 non-white pixels, all the rotated right-panel y-axis label, which clears the left panel's marks (left axes end at x=650). Within the right panel the direct labels '+0.043' (top of its interval 0.140) and '+0.220' (top of its interval 0.315) sit above and to the right of their intervals in clear space, and neither touches the dotted zero rule or the other label.
